facts.name: Dawn D. Nichols
facts.assignment: Flagler Administrative Judge; Divisions24 Drug Court and50 felony criminal. Limited noncivil office-operations review.

contact.contact_note: PDF includes assistant middle initial; profile uses Michele Westfall. Shared office telephone; personal judicial email not established.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Email assistant with case number/name, motion docket number and requested time, copying parties; immediately file and serve notice after reservation. Notify assistant and file cancellation notice; court-set hearings require court cancellation.

proposed_orders.summary: Submit Word or PDF through e-portal Pleading on Existing Case unless judge instructs otherwise. Linked order instruction rejects mailed/emailed orders.

remote_appearances.summary: Zoom available on motion requesting communication technology; no automatic permission inferred.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant with identifying case information and copy all parties except legally authorized ex parte communications.

courtesy_copies.summary: Case-law courtesy copies may be emailed, mailed or hand delivered; electronic PDF/A or Word preferred.

conferral.summary: Separate general conferral requirement not established in basic noncivil office review.

facts.summary: Email scheduling and communications; proposed orders through existing-case e-portal route; Zoom requires motion. Criminal/diversion substance not reviewed.

review_scope.collected: Full profile, six-page practices PDF and one-page order-submission instruction.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Profile identity/assignment/contacts; practices pages1–4 basic office operations and one-page submission instruction.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Criminal merits, trial/exhibit/plea requirements, drug-court manuals and detailed calendar; practices pages5–6 collected only.

conflicts.statement: Nichols linked undated instruction says Flagler lacks direct proposed-order option; Distler August2026 instructions require that option. Preserve as judge-specific sourced statements, not a resolved countywide rule.

gaps: Personal judicial email and distinct assistant-only telephone not established.

citations.name: practices
citations.locator: Pages1–4 contacts and basic office operations; later pages collected only
